verdict.rationale: Drata's own developer docs claim it can "Automate questionnaires and manage your trust center programmatically" as part of accelerating security reviews, and it documents a SafeBase Trust Center, so questionnaire automation is a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence shows that AI drafts answers from the customer's actual controls or knowledge base, or that drafts go through a human review workflow. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-generated answers, sourcing answers from controls/evidence/knowledge base, a draft-review-approve workflow, spreadsheet/portal questionnaire import, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
